// Run from the pinned Tempo module root with go run -mod=vendor.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/api"
)

func main() {
	type Case struct {
		Mode string `json:"mode"`
		Limit string `json:"limit"`
		Accepted bool `json:"accepted"`
		Max uint32 `json:"max"`
		Target string `json:"target,omitempty"`
	}
	cases := []Case{}
	for _,mode := range []string{"names","values"} {
		for _,limit := range []string{"", "0", "1", "5000", "4294967295", "4294967296", "-1", "+1", "five", "001"} {
			r := httptest.NewRequest("GET","http://tempo/api/v2/search/tags?scope=span&limit="+url.QueryEscape(limit)+"&tag=span.wrong%252Ftarget",nil)
			c := Case{Mode:mode,Limit:limit}
			if mode == "names" {
				_,err := api.ParseSearchTagsRequest(r); c.Accepted = err == nil
			} else {
				r = mux.SetURLVars(r,map[string]string{api.MuxVarTagName:"span.correct"})
				req,err := api.ParseSearchTagValuesRequestV2(r)
				c.Accepted = err == nil
				if err == nil { c.Max,c.Target = req.MaxTagValues,req.TagName }
			}
			cases = append(cases,c)
		}
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout); enc.SetIndent("","  ")
	if err := enc.Encode(cases); err != nil { panic(err) }
}
